newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to redeem callable notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to redeem callable notes.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Monday that on Saturday, February 1 it will redeem the following callable notes in their entirety:

*Accrued interest of $35.10 per $1,000 face amount will be paid on Monday, February 3. The notes are worth a par amount of $50 million. **Accrued interest of $35.15 per $1,000 face amount will be paid on February 3. The notes are worth a par amount of $25 million.
Sallie Mae said principal will be repaid at 100 percent of the face amount. Payment will be made to holders of record as of the close of business January 31, it said.
